title: Direct vs Retrograde
caption:
direct vs retrograde: what's the difference? 🌙
Nothing really goes backward. Earth is just passing it.
cta:
send this to someone who only knows their sun sign 👀
your full chart is free on align, link in bio

ask: Your chart has both. Do you know which is which?
explainA: when it moves forward through the signs.
explainB: *Retrograde* is when it seems to move backward.
It's an illusion from our own orbit.
